blocking_findings: U00-U08 is a disconnected second root with no executable ambiguity edge, fencing, or cancellation semantics.
Traceability is round-robin rather than semantic; bootstrap, forward recovery, and typed evidence map to unrelated nodes and commands.
The app-config bootstrap boundary has no implementation lane, while X41 assigns bootstrap work to release-platform-config.
M01-M19 are generic and omit exact targets/assets; commands and schemas are not node/operation specific.
Temporal authority is asserted by node IDs instead of predecessor evidence, and validator-report/predecessor-council hash closure is missing.
Sigstore and Vault live signer kinds are allowlisted without cryptographic or identity verification, allowing forged live publication authority.
Negative vectors are prose metadata and do not execute mutations or independently measure zero effects.
Four-way mutation separation checks only distinct strings and does not verify authenticated roles, linked records, target bytes, signatures, or journal chain.
Candidate, Vault, CNPG, and admin contracts validate shape but not executable authority or lifecycle semantics.
Trace mappings and mandatory validator-report council binding are incomplete.
No app-config bootstrap path exists and release-platform-config remains absent.
Live capacity is not three-node N-1; Kata, admission, NetworkPolicy, and CNPG/Vault evidence are absent.
Postgres defaults remain one instance, backups disabled, and legacy secret integration; expected/observed evidence is unconstrained.
Validator hashes fixture constants, does not enforce live time windows, and accepts unverified signer kinds.
Release-version assumptions require reconciliation with newer v0.7.x tags.
A synthetic record relabeled live with arbitrary Sigstore metadata was accepted as publication authority.
Expired 2020 evidence and the same nonce across validator invocations were accepted.
Only six mutations execute; remaining negatives are labels with declared effect_count zero.
Requirement trace rows and AC/tests are generic and semantically incorrect.
Council binding is optional and omits validator-report hash; admin executor separation and four-party chain isolation are unenforced.

consensus.summary: All four lanes verified reproducibility but rejected v2.2 because live authority is forgeable, replay/freshness and zero-effect oracles are unenforced, recovery and bootstrap scheduling are incomplete, semantic traceability/publication targets are absent, and council closure is optional.
